name: Montnets Cloud Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Montnets Cloud Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the mobile communication business in China and internationally. It offers IM Cloud, an integrated communication platform that achieves instant message communication for enterprises by utilizing text, pictures, audio, and video based on internet and service provider networks. Terminal Cloud gathers all-terminal manufacturers and provides an all-scenario ability to offer B2C services, and a marketing portal based on the 5G network and mobile terminals, with B2C content subscription, business socializing, SMS enhancement, and fast application solutions.
